notes.title: Taboo University Book Two Release 3 has launched!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/b17612ceb73e885c0df48cd28ada858fc23eeae8.png"]

The new Release for Taboo University - Book 2 is now available. 



👂❓ What's new, you ask? Good question! Lots - that's what. 

Each of the storylines reaches a tense climax in this chapter, setting the stage for the entire rest of the game - it's deep, it's emotional, and most importantly, it's hot as fuck - with Mc reaping the many, many benefits.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/162ed295b46dab2e8efd08f84724a59a564063e6.png"]



🥇In the Winner's club, we've got you being torn between many of the tense and worried characters of the club, all looking to you for support:

-- Monika of all people is looking for any chance to blow off some steam, and seeing you and Olesya being casually friendly during a practice is just the bad reason she needs to make a sexy scene out of herself for you.

-- Isa needs help as well! With no one else to turn to in confidence, she seeks you out to ask for your help in her election efforts amid the drug scandal. Should you be on her path instead of Sam's, she's even willing to trust you to help calm her nerves a bit...

-- Silvia is feeling a little isolated with all the negativity as well, and unfortunately, she's been pretty swamped to the point of frustration, leading her to take some indulgent initiative with her new boyfriend the first chance she gets!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/c3d1c35843a31e50ee7cb85197f42d0b0566dd52.png"]



🍃Meanwhile, the mysterious Children of Narrura are far from idle. Mc makes some serious investigative plays in this chapter in order to learn more information.

- Fortunately, Delphia has always been someone to find enjoyment in breaking the rules, and fortunately, when she finds out you're sneaking around, she is turned towards rewarding you rather than chastising you.

- Afterward, someone else is looking to do a little rule-breaking of her own... Ivy wants another taste after your previous tryst, and she has just the plan to wear out the rest of the communers - Yvonne, Sloan, and Nirium -  to get some private time with you.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/937a267c28550063b60a8d8ecf3a0d16be0bed55.png"]



💰Finally, big happenings in the Syndicate.

- If you were brave (or foolish) enough to make contact with Corrine before her more altruistic sister, it's time for her to earn her keep - in exchange for bail. With her back on the streets, though, she's more than poised to make that everyone else's problem... and your pleasure.

- And it's time to find out if the Wasp's money is where their mouths are. The task of testing this supposed golden business deal falls to you, Zemfira and Foxy. It's good - it's better than good, even. And at Zemfira's prodding, it might get even better... 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/2285299aa7bc40f8087437ca0cf356e730457193.png"]

 And that's just the beginning. There's tons more to see waiting for you, culminating in a big, big decision for Mc to make at the end. Faced with the results of the choices he's made so far, it's time to stop passing the buck... who are you? What do you want? And what are you willing to do to get it?

  🔥 17 shining scenes 🔥 2700 stunning renders 🔥 166 original animations

The hour is here - no more waiting. Time to act. Dive back into the world of Taboo University today!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44282020/e2b77e62decccdda105efd026afca44dcd8dddb9.png"]

notes.title: The 9th update of Fetish Locator: S&M Studio is live on Patreon!
notes.notes:
Hey, friends!

Since the point when you and Stacy left everything behind to chase your dreams and conquer the world of adult cinema, it’s all been leading to this. This is the moment in the adventure where fantasies become reality, and ideas take form on screen. 



In the ninth release of S&M Studio, you’ll shoot your very first feature-length film in your own studio—complete with models, sets, and a script that you and your team brought to life together.

This is far more than just a technical leap forward. It’s a creative milestone, packed with passion, challenges, and ambition. And with so many juicy behind-the-scenes events, you’ll get to see familiar characters in entirely new ways. 



Working with Stacy, Kanya, and Taisia, you’ll go through every step of production: writing the script, building the sets, designing costumes, and finally shooting your masterpiece. This storyline of making a movie is the heart of the 9th release—and trust us, you won’t want to miss a second of it. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/ca4fd2b21f66fc5c9745c5d6583f03bc2257aff5.png"]

But the action doesn’t stop on the set. A sudden cyberattack hits the IT department’s servers—and now the whole team is counting on you and your brilliant tech experts, April and Nari.

You’ll need to act fast and work as one to stop the threat and save the project. And after that kind of stress, there’s only one thing left to do… help the girls unwind. 



Let’s start with Claire. A closed-door office meeting with her quickly turns into something far more personal. Just be sure to be mindful that in the office, you never know who else is watching. 



If you've stuck around through April's stubbornness, you'll now get to see a new side of her as she tries to balance her work at Orbix and her responsibilities to her bandmates. The code monkey offers you a chance to go for a jog in the park, just be sure to keep up, or you might miss out on the thrilling ending.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/2a2b910dd0957e27dc5e5da5a32655cd1b0db907.png"]

For fans of Lyssa, we’ve got a double treat in this update. First, you’ll head out on a playful and colorful date at the amusement park with both Lyssa and Stacy. Then, back at your studio, get ready for a sizzling photoshoot with the sexiest lawyer you know.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337841/563690fc8390de0602ee4156e162e15f4528e2e7.png"]

💥 Here’s what’s waiting for you in this release:

— 25 new scenes  

— 3718 new renders  

— 251 animations



We want to thank each and every one of you for your patience, support, and love for this project. You’re the reason we keep pushing ourselves to make each update better than the last. 



And just a reminder—S&M Studio now has an official Steam page so you can wishlist it right not to stay updated.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763690/Fetish_Locator_SM_Studio/"][/dynamiclink]



See you on set! 🎬💋
